principle: Curriculum selects what capability to study; Ops physical truth decides EXPERIMENT or NO_CHANGE; product promotion is a separate decision.

templates.title: Prompt Change Experiment
templates.question: A bounded prompt change 是否改善 mapping 行為且不破壞既有 case？
templates.trigger: 有可觀察的 prompt-sensitive failure 或明確 hypothesis
baseline: record current outputs and eval receipt
treatment: change exactly one prompt decision surface
templates.promotion_gate: Only after measured improvement plus a real product need.

templates.title: Eval Scope Audit
templates.question: 現有 PASS 結果實際證明了什麼，哪些能力沒有被測到？
templates.trigger: 已有 eval/result，但 conclusion scope 可能強於 evidence
treatment: classify each case by the capability actually tested
templates.promotion_gate: This template never authorizes product promotion by itself.

templates.title: RAG Need Decision
templates.question: 產品是否真的存在 external knowledge dependency，值得建立 retrieval experiment？
templates.trigger: 答案品質受外部、可更新或私有知識取得限制
treatment: bounded retrieval experiment; do not add vector DB to canonical path first
templates.promotion_gate: Promotion requires repeated product need and evidence beyond the isolated lab.

templates.title: Agent Workflow Decision
templates.question: 固定 workflow 是否已出現需要 dynamic tool/next-action choice 的真實 decision barrier？
templates.trigger: 多步工具選擇或 recovery 不能由 deterministic owner 直接決定
treatment: isolate one agent decision while deterministic owners keep transition authority
templates.promotion_gate: Agent behavior must improve a real workflow without replacing mechanical owner truth.

templates.title: Fine-tuning / LoRA Decision
templates.question: Prompt/base-model approaches 是否有穩定、可重現的 domain gap，值得做 fine-tuning experiment？
templates.trigger: 固定 eval 顯示 repeated domain-specific error that prompting/model routing cannot resolve economically
templates.promotion_gate: Tuned model never replaces production automatically; product owner reviews need, quality and serving cost.

examples.note: 4/4 historical smoke is useful evidence, not representative product correctness.
